display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
Chosen by record_failure:
config error (401, 403, 404) -> config_error
daily quota 429 -> quota_exhausted
temporary 429 -> rate_limited
network or timeout -> unreachable
5xx -> server_error
breaker opened -> circuit_open
anything else -> degraded

div.style: display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.p:
UI label: healthy = Gemini or Groq Connected,
available = Ready, failing = Unavailable,
quota_exhausted = Quota Exhausted,
config_error = Configuration Error,
offline = Offline Mode Active.
